Unlike IngestAudienceMembers (which adds users to specific advertiser audience lists for targeting), `IngestUsers` ingests account level identity linkage data (for example, user identifiers linked to mobile IDs) independent of specific audience segments. This feature is only available to accounts on an allowlist.
